item.title: Former Ohio State Wide Receivers Coach Brian Hartline to Make $3.5 Million in First Year As Head Coach of South Florida
item.description: Brian Hartline's new job comes with new money, too. Per records obtained by The Columbus Dispatch, the former Ohio State wide receivers coach and offensive coordinator will receive a $3.5 million salary in his first year as head coach of South Florida. It's a $1.5 million bump from his $2 million salary as the Buckeyes' OC in 2025. That $3.5 million figure places Hartline among the highest-paid coaches in the Group of Five.
